articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed, avg 8 published/cycle (51 yesterday); 1 article quarantined

experiment: Skipped — no active experiments and no pause gate, but today is the first clean day after five pipeline changes on 09-25/26 (US cap, 12h pool, running-story dedup, optional science floor, pool widening). One day is not a baseline; revisit on 2026-09-30 with three clean days.
weakestArea: Science is furthest from target at 3/5 (5 yesterday), pulling sci+tech to 24% against 25%. The science floor is optional by design since 2026-09-26, and only Phys.org and Dawn supplied science. If the shortfall holds through 09-30, the next lever is widening science sources in CURATED_SOURCES, provided it stays NewsAPI token-neutral, rather than raising the floor.
watching: Strait of Hormuz: IRGC seized a second REMUS 600 drone, Qeshm blasts, and a Saudi rejection of the PGSA transit fees, while US-Iran talks stall.
Serbia: Vučić resigns the presidency to run for prime minister.
Gaza and the West Bank: Smotrich's annexation push and the fallout from the Al-Aqsa storming.
AI safety: OpenAI paused frontier training after safety incidents (state/advocacy-only sourcing so far), alongside the Amodei–Trump dinner.
Sudan: RSF drone strikes on the Wad Madani fuel depot in Gezira.
coverageGaps: Science: 3 stories from 2 outlets; nothing from dedicated science journals or agencies beyond Phys.org.
India skews the Asia count: about 6 of 7 AS stories are Indian domestic (Assam, Manipur, Maharashtra, Delhi, the CEC, the bank strike), and East and Southeast Asia is almost absent.
No Oceania stories, and Latin America has just enough coverage to meet its target (Haiti only).
Freshness was computed on only 2 of 42 articles today, so the median is not representative.
context: US datelines fell from 40% to 21%, and Latin America reached 5% on the first full day under the US cap and the widened pool. Both targets were met for the first time, but that is one day of data. Multi-source share held at 43%, and there were no same-event duplicates. One article (Oleshky drone deliveries) was quarantined as .md.bad.
